result.summary: The page is generally polished, but horizontal carousel content is awkwardly clipped and a nearby restaurant appears duplicated.

issues.description: The category row and “Fastest near you” carousel overflow the right edge, leaving a partial blank pill and cutting off the third restaurant image, name, and delivery details.
issues.suggestion: Tune card widths, gaps, and horizontal padding so the next item is either shown as a deliberate, readable preview or remains fully off-screen until scrolled.

issues.description: “Green Bowl Poké” appears twice consecutively with the same image, delivery time, and fee, making the carousel look duplicated or incorrectly populated.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate the restaurant data or display distinct locations/details if these are separate listings.
